name: Crazy Train
reference: Crazy Train (138 BPM): Ozzy Osbourne, Blizzard of Ozz (1980, Ridge Farm; Randy Rhoads, eng. Max Norman)
rig: 1974 Les Paul Custom (stock, bridge pickup) -> MXR Distortion+ (Output 10, Distortion 4, almost always on) -> MXR 10-band EQ (125 Hz +3, 250 +7, 500 +10, 1k +6, 2k +3, 4k -2, 16k +3) -> Marshall 100 W 1959 Super Lead on a Variac at ~90-92 V -> two 4x12s (1960A/B with Altec 417-8H per Guitar World); amps in Ridge Farm's stone room, SM58 close, AKG 451 a few feet back, SM87 room mics. Rhythm double-tracked L/R; solos triple-tracked; Max Norman's AMS DMX 15-80S detune at mixdown.
notes: Amp: Marshall's 1959RR Randy Rhoads reissue, channel 1 gain at noon (GW's Vol I ~6; the Distortion+ supplies the rest). Drive (always on): the MXR Distortion+ capture at exactly GW's Output 10 / Distortion 4, with the 10-band EQ curve mapped onto its six-band eq [2, 5, 7, 4, -1, 1] (100/250/650/1600/3500/8k, scaled ~0.7 to stay safe). GW's knob and EQ settings are by-ear estimates (Tonal Recall), not session notes. Cab: Greenback 1960TV SM57; no Altec 417-8H IR exists in the catalog. SW8 BOOST = TS9 clean push (not on the record: the 80s banks keep a boost on every preset). SW9 DELAY = a 380 ms short solo delay (Owsinski: the solo has only a short AMS delay on the right). 480L Large Wood Room at 15% for the Ridge Farm stone room. Can't match: the AMS detune and the triple-tracked solos (mono preset). Research: the 80s-tones.md shortlist (ids checked with `tone3000.py models`). Levelled offline with rigsim --exact to -14 LUFS.

left.label: Ibanez TS9 clean push, D0 T6 L10 (lead boost, not on the record)
MXR Distortion+ O-10 D-4 + MXR 10-band EQ curve
Marshall 1959RR Randy Rhoads Super Lead, CH1 gain at noon
Marshall 1960TV 4x12 G12M-25 Greenback, SM57 (for the Altec 417-8H cabs)
Solo delay 380 ms (the AMS short delay)
Lexicon 480L Large Wood Room (Ridge Farm stone room)
